title: Knew Bigelow at the Rockefeller ranch

tellings.quote: Bigalow was one of those. But I knew him at the Rockefeller ranch in 93.

plain: Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs, says he knew the businessman Robert Bigelow, who has paid for UFO research, at the ranch of the philanthropist Laurance Rockefeller in Wyoming in 1993. Greer tells Michels this from his own experience, in passing, as a sign of how close he was to the wealthy backers of UFO research at the time.
